title: 2819 CHURCH & THE ACCESS PORTAL TO HELL

sense.text:
“Go ye therefore, and teach all nations”: Christ is speaking to his disciples, and telling them where to go. The “ye” are his disciples, Israelites, and the nations he sends them to are the twelve tribes of Israel scattered abroad in all nations. This scripture is talking about the Israelites. It has nothing to do with Christianity.

The wicked have sought to take Matthew 28:19 and put it into Christianity and make a quote-unquote church out of it, the 28:19 church. When you hear the term 28:19, do not allow witchcraft to make you think the scripture in Matthew 28 has anything to do with that evil going on in that arena. They put so much pressure, advertisement and media coverage behind it to make you associate the two. They shamed it by doing that. That is God’s scripture, and they should not have put their nasty hands on it. Associating Matthew 28:19 with that garbage is an abomination. Making the arena a portal, a spiritual tunnel to heaven, with the music, the lights and the camera angles, is witchcraft, used to wipe the people’s minds clean of anything righteous. Where in the Bible did God tell the teachers of Israel to do that? Jacob’s ladder at Bethel was the connection between the Most High and the Israelites. That portal takes the people straight to hell.

“Baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost”: baptizing means teaching them repentance, converting them, sanctifying them. Not the holy ghost, holy filled business learned in church. It is about repentance and coming back to the commandments.

“Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you”: teaching the Israelites to keep his commandments. So how do you name a church Matthew 28:19 when you are clearly going against the scripture? The scripture itself says to teach the people to observe what Christ commanded, and that is exactly what that church will not do.

“And, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world”: who is the ye? Christ was speaking to his disciples, the Israelites, and he was sending them to the Israelites.

precepts.why:
Same book, ten chapters earlier: “These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not.” He was meaning the northern kingdom at that time, because they were not ready for this gospel yet. They were in the idolatry, and Christ had to do that fixing, mending the tribes back together. This was never for the nations.

“But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.” He was meaning Judah. Judah was supposed to get it first; the Most High set it up that way. Even now he is going to raise the tents of Judah first, so that the other tribes don’t magnify themselves against Judah, because there was an envy between the two kingdoms. Christ said, I have to fix that, but right now I am coming to you, Judah. And when Judah would not have it, Paul and the apostles were sent to deal with the northern kingdom brothers. That is what the rest of the New Testament is about.

So the “all nations” of Matthew 28:19 cannot be the other nations. The same Christ who said “Go not into the way of the Gentiles” is not now sending his disciples to everybody.

Proof that there was a difference between Judah and the rest of Israel: “Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you”. To you Jews, meaning the tribes of Judah, the southern kingdom.

“But seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.” The Jews who put it from them were mainly the Pharisees. And the Gentiles here are not all nations, as the churches make you think. The Gentiles were the tribes of Israel that went away from the covenants, the northern kingdom that was in the idolatry. It was never talking about the other nations. It was talking about the Israelites of the northern kingdom.

The biblical scholars know this. The slick pastors they set up in their churches know more than what they teach. Their job is to keep our people in spiritual bondage, and that is why the opposition against this truth is so great.

It was not even all of Judah that put the word from them: “Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed; And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.”

Some of the Judahites believed on Christ, like Nicodemus. It was the majority, the scribes and the Pharisees, that were against Christ. So when Paul says “ye put it from you”, it is that group. The word went to Judah first, and those of Judah who continued in it were his disciples indeed.

Acts uses the word nations: “And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.” That is who “all nations” is about: Israelites dwelling out of every nation under heaven. This was the time of quote-unquote Pentecost, the firstfruits, an Israelite holy day they made a Pentecostal church out of. It has nothing to do with that. Go into any of these witch covens, these crack houses called churches, and you can bet none of them said anything against quote-unquote Halloween.

Christianity is the arm of slavery, the perfection and the extension of slavery, to keep our minds as perfect slaves: to make you hate your own selves and love your oppressors. The word Christian is in the Bible three times, and there is a difference between being called Christians and Christianity. Christian means anointed, the anointed people of God. The Israelites were called Christians because we were rolling with the anointed attitude of Christ, but that is not our nationality; our nationality is the nation of Israel. Christianity is the slavery white supremacist doctrine, a doctrine for slaves, to keep us docile.

When you read Deuteronomy, there are three times we were supposed to appear in Jerusalem, and this was one of them. That is how the twelve tribes scattered abroad knew to come to Jerusalem at that time.

“The multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.” The multitude of Israelites came together on that high holy day. “Behold, are not all these which speak Galileans?” The Galileans, the apostles, spoke Hebrew. Yet “how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?” They were speaking Hebrew, but when the words got to the ears of the hearers, the angels were translating it so that each understood in the language from where he came. That is what the cloven tongues were about, not that glossolalia garbage they do in church that nobody understands.

The places are named so you can get it: “Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia”, all the way to “strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes”. So the book of Romans was not written to white people. It was written to the Israelites scattered in Rome too. The proselytes were people returning to the Most High. And they all said, “we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.” Every nation under heaven there was Israelites hearing the gospel.

“James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.” The wonderful works of God were being sent to the twelve tribes scattered abroad. That is who the apostles wrote to, and that is who the nations of Matthew 28:19 are.

“Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia”. Remember the strangers of Rome, and Pontus and Cappadocia in Acts 2. The strangers are the twelve tribes scattered abroad. So the Galatians are the Israelites scattered abroad.

That means when you read in the book of Revelation about the seven churches scattered throughout Asia Minor, those are all Israelites too. So 28:19 is talking about the Israelites. Who was in these nations? The twelve tribes of Israel.

Baptizing them means teaching them repentance, and that is what sanctifying is: “Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.” Sanctify means to cleanse them, to clean up the people with the word of God. What is in the word of God? The commandments. That is what cleans us up.

The Bible demands that you change. It demands that you repent, and it makes you a disciplined man and woman of God. Once you are changed, you don’t commit sin like you did before; every day you die daily, getting more sin out of your life. You are going to struggle a little, because those things were woven deep into your spirit by Satan and his minions, these black preachers, and a black preacher ain’t nothing but a white preacher with a black skin, teaching white supremacy doctrine. The people going into those witch covens hate what the Bible demands.

“Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.” That is what sanctified means: except you be converted, except you be changed. Become as little children: learn this Bible again, and shut the hell up, instead of running your mouth about scriptures you don’t even understand.

If you don’t change, if you don’t repent, if you don’t learn to keep the commandments of God, you will not make the kingdom. The people going inside that witch coven talking about some portal ain’t getting none of this, and the man over there knows it. There is such a thing as a sellout: they will take the paycheck and destroy their whole people wholesale.

“Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you”, and what did Christ command? “If ye love me, keep my commandments.” That is what is supposed to be going on in the churches. They say they love Jesus, Jesus, Jesus; well, if they love Jesus, keep his commandments.

So how do you name a witch coven 28:19 when you are clearly going against the scripture? Matthew 28:19 sends the disciples to teach the Israelites to keep the commandments, and that church teaches the opposite.

Baptizing them means converting them, and here is what converts: “The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul”. That is what Christ meant in Matthew 18:3, except ye be converted. His commandments are perfect. The law changes your spirit and changes your behavior. It stops a sinner from sinning, an adulterer from committing adultery, a fornicator from fornication, a thief from stealing. The Most High cleaned us up, whatever we were into.

“The testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.” It takes a simple brother or sister and turns them into wise men and wise women, and that is what a slave master does not want; he will use his imps to keep you in slavery.

So when they see us come through, they see us converted, meaning we came back. We did not convert to something that was never ours; we came back to what we were lost from. You were born an Israelite; you only have to relearn. That is what repent means, to be brought back; reconcile, to bring back; return, to come back to me. We were brought to this country to serve captivity. This is not our rest and not our home. Like a man in prison, we bide our time and get off with good behavior by following what the Lord said. You are not mediocre. God put his spirit in you.

sense.text:
“Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David”. Did she curse at him? Did she rebuke him, the way they were doing us? No. Those are some kind words. She was intreating him kindly. “My daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.” Certainly, she thought, he could help with that.

Why deal with this at all? Because the Christianity preachers are trying to make you think Christ is for everybody. When black folks subscribe to that and advocate for it, what we are really saying is that we think so low of ourselves we have to be for everybody, while everybody hates us and we are okay with that.

“But he answered her not a word.” She didn’t curse at him to make him ignore her. What kind of Jesus is this, that they say sent his disciples out to all nations? Christ didn’t even dignify her with a response. And then they say we are twisting scripture.

“And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.” The disciples begged Jesus to tell this woman to get the hell out of there. Why? Because Christ had already instructed them five chapters earlier not to go into the way of the Gentiles. The disciples were in order. They understood the order, and we have to learn that.

“But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.” But means only. If Christ says “I am not sent”, where is he going? Nowhere, but only unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel. That is crystal clear, and it is in all the Bibles.

Who sent Christ? The Father. That order did not come from Christ himself; it came from the one who sent him, and the beginning of the New Testament, Matthew 1:21, shows what the Father said. Why are our people not reading this? Because they are under a spell called Christianity, which is witchcraft.
“Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.” He had already told her what he was there for, and now she is grabbing Christ by the knees, begging him.

“But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.” This tells you Christ got mad: I already told you what I am here for. It is not right for me to disregard what my Father told me to do, and take the healing power and the blessings meant for the children of Israel and cast them to dogs. The children’s bread is the gifts, and they were for Israel.

precepts.why:
She called Christ “thou Son of David” with kind words. They don’t call us the sons of God yet, but they are going to. The Most High is going to exalt his people: “I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.”

When people respond to you as fine gold, they are not saying anything evil against you, not cursing you out or putting hexes on you. We are not getting that respect now, but it is coming. The Most High is going to bring us to that point, those of us who endure and stay in this truth and this righteousness. He is going to make us greater than the finest gold, for Ophir is the finest gold.

Prove that the children’s bread was the gifts: “These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.” Don’t go to the other nations, and when it said the other nations it was only talking about the Israelites; don’t even deal with the northern kingdom yet.

“And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.” Who was going to hear that message? The Israelites. The kingdom and the healing and the blessings were the bread for the children, and later Christ expanded it to the northern tribes, because they were all part of the Israelite nation anyway.

sense.text:
Read first to answer who sent Christ, when he told the woman of Canaan that he was not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel. The Father sent him, so see what the Father said.

“And she shall bring forth a son”: the angel Gabriel is telling Joseph about the child his wife is going to bring forth. Did Gabriel come with his own thoughts? No. He came with the thoughts and the directions of the Most High God. From the start the Father said whom the son was for, and that is why Christ answered the woman the way he did.

“Thou shalt call his name JESUS”: you, Joseph, shall call his name Savior. That is what Jesus means.

“For he shall save his people from their sins.” For means because: this is the reason he is called Savior. Is his people everybody? No. That is what the whole Bible is about. He saves his people from their sins because the Israelites were in sin. That is why he told the woman caught in adultery, Go and sin no more. He is not talking about the other nations; they didn’t have the covenants or the laws, and the Lord did not deal with them.

The lying pastors will tell you his people is everybody. Christianity has messed our people up with certain scriptures because the people don’t read. Sixty thousand people in that arena, and maybe eight of them had a Bible, talking about some damn portal.

precepts.why:
Who are his people? Paul answers: “I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid.” God said no, I have not cast away my people. “For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.” Paul lets everybody know he is one of the people the verse is discussing: of the seed, the sperm, of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin, because there are twelve tribes.

This is in the New Testament, in Paul’s writings, and people try to say the new God has some new people, some spiritual Israelites. Romans 9 killed all that. “God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew.” The ones he knew in the past are the ones he knows now.

“Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel”. That intercession is what Christ was about, to bring Israel back to him. And that so-called portal is a portal to hell, with abominations allowed in there that guarantee your ticket to destruction.

Find out whom the Most High knew in the past, because those are the same ones he is bringing back today: “Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel”. That is his people. “Against the whole family”: no s on that word, so family means one nation, “which I brought up from the land of Egypt”.

“You only have I known of all the families of the earth”. There is that only again, the same only as when Christ said he was not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel. That is the “foreknew” of Romans 11. Of all the families of the earth, I only know you. Those are the ones spoken of in the New Testament. The people have been seriously duped in church.

“Therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.” I will punish you Israelites because you are my children: I had a covenant with you. Keep my commandments and I bless you above all nations; break them and I curse you and put you on the bottom. And when I have had enough of you going many days without a sacrifice, I send my son, the only sacrifice I will allow, the lamb that redeems you back to me. Christianity lies about this, and they get a big paycheck to make sure you never wake up. You don’t know how special you are. Every soul in the nation of Israel counts.

sense.text:
There is such a thing as a sellout, and this is the spirit we are dealing with. “Now such was the height of Greek fashions, and increase of heathenish manners”: that is what was going on with our people, just like now. On the blitzes to get our people to repent, the brothers can tell you the full turned-up wickedness our people are into; it sounded like the time of Acts, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

“Through the exceeding profaneness of Jason, that ungodly wretch, and no high priest”. Jason was the high priest who bought his way in; he didn’t even earn it. No high priest for real. Pam is our people; T.D. Jakes, these guys are our people. But they will sell their people down the river for a paycheck to stay in the good graces of massa. You gain the whole world and lose your own soul by lying to them.

“That the priests had no courage to serve any more at the altar, but despising the temple, and neglecting the sacrifices, hastened to be partakers of the unlawful allowance in the place of exercise”. Jason was leading the people to follow Greek customs, as these preachers lead our people into the ways of the nations.

“Then came ungodly persons, who hated their own people”: you have pastors that literally hate their congregation. Old women, old men and kids coming in there trying to get themselves right, and men who hate their own people are teaching them a doctrine that is going to get them killed. How do you know? If they hear what we are bringing out, why don’t they go and teach it to their congregation? They know we ain’t lying, and they can’t ignore what the Bible says.

“Went unto the king, and told him that Jonathan besieged the tower”: quote-unquote snitched. That is what happened in the time of Nat Turner, Denmark Vesey and Gabriel Prosser, when we were trying to get our way out of slavery. Some went and snitched and got the brothers jacked up, because they loved massa so much they could not see themselves without massa. That is called trauma bonding, and it runs deep.

People take the numbers 28:19 and call it the church of Pam. No: Matthew 28:19 is not befitting of them at all, and that was proved. Proverbs 28:9 is more befitting of that church. “He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.”

So what portal are they talking about going into when they are all in sin? They tell the women they can stay in pants. They tell the men they don’t have to change, they can stay effeminate. Pam said that marriage is not the goal. That is why it is called the access portal to hell.

While the people were lined up to get inside that place, all the Israelites were doing was reading the commandments of God to them, and they rebuked us for reading God’s law. That shows they hate the Bible. The law is what corrects us and straightens us out, and a preacher who tells you to turn your ears away from the law is leading you to the place where even your prayer is abomination.

precepts.why:
“To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.” If Pam or any of these preachers speak without the word of God, why in the world are you in there? Because the people in there are not looking for the word of God either.

There is no light in them: the truth is not in them, the commandments are not in them. That is what the light is, the commandments, and they are not teaching them at all. They teach lies and abominations. Our brothers and sisters on the outside need to start looking to see whether the preacher is actually coming out of that Bible.

They hate the Bible so much that if they could kill us they would do it wholesale. They want to get rid of the Israelites; that is the big talk going on upstairs. Get the right Bible, the King James. The newer versions twist the slave-ship prophecy of Deuteronomy 28 into something else, as if God of the universe would not speak about hundreds of years of ships packed to the brim with our people. Deuteronomy 28 is talking about us.

Proverbs 28:9 speaks of him that turns away his ear from the law; a preacher is telling you to turn your ears from the law. “Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven”. Shall teach men and women to break God’s commandments: you can’t get any clearer. Called the least means he ain’t going; he is going to be put to death, and everybody following him too. If you teach your congregation that marriage is not the goal and being single is, that is the portal to hell.

“Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.” The only law done away with was the laws of sacrifice, because the man speaking here took the place of that set of laws. When Christ died, that allowed us to learn how to keep the commandments in righteousness. That is what he told the woman caught in adultery: Go and sin no more. Pam is not doing that because he was not sent to do that; he tells you to stay in sin to connect you to the portal to hell.

“Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.” Everything in this Bible will be fulfilled, every commandment and every prophecy, and marriage is part of those commandments. They are not going to stop this truth.

“But whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.” That is why we ain’t worried about anything they can do. We do and teach the commandments to save our people’s lives, so that they don’t end up in God’s judgment. At the end of the day we are going to win.

sense.text:
Pam told the people that singleness is not a curse and marriage is not the goal, with the hands moving, the lights on him and the camera angles, theatrics frying people’s brains. The Bible says “Marriage is honourable in all”. A straight contradiction. So what kind of portal is that? A portal to complete destruction.

Why does it say in all? Because marriage is what started off everything. When a man and a woman get married, that is the potential to produce righteousness on the earth. Every human being comes out of the coming together of man and woman, and God says that is supposed to be done under the covenant, the agreement of marriage, and he has laws on it. There is not supposed to be a single woman anywhere without a man responsible for her: if it ain’t her husband, it’s her father. What he is really saying is, you women don’t need to marry real men; be married to white Jesus.

“And the bed undefiled”: the bed is undefiled when it is a married man and a married woman, married to each other by the laws of God. Paperwork. Not some ketubah, a piece of paper with something written on it; you have legal papers for your car and your house.

“But whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.” Single and fornicating is going to get you killed. That is exactly why our community is so jacked up: the laws of God are not being taught, followed or preached. Sisters, value yourselves better than these philosophies.

precepts.why:
“I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house”. So what is this preacher saying, that women aren’t supposed to marry but are going to have babies anyway? That is fornication. She is supposed to learn all of that from her mother and her father.

“Give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.” If we don’t do this, we give our enemies occasion to mock us, to make us a laughingstock and shame the nation, and they have shamed us. Our women are programmed to be rebellious as hell, and the men are too weak to fix it. So they changed the preacher: put him in sweats and sneakers, let him act like a rapper, a manufactured negro to appeal to real brothers. Real brothers see through it: a white man with black skin and sneakers on. Portal to hell.

The Bible means what it says about the unlawful bed: “For children begotten of unlawful beds are witnesses of wickedness against their parents in their trial.” An unlawful bed means the man and woman in the bed are not married. That is fornication, and that is sin.

You can’t tell a woman to stay single forever; she wants a man, she will fall into fornication and into the judgment, because she was not taught to be married first. The children are witnesses of wickedness against their parents, who taught them nothing, and against a community that doesn’t care: single women with baby carriages and no man, and nobody asks, Sister, where is your husband? Where is the father of this baby? That is supposed to be a shame.

So the bed of Hebrews 13:4 is undefiled only because the two are married to each other by the laws of God.

sense.text:
Here is how they are going to hell. “Therefore my people are gone into captivity”: why did we go onto those slave ships? Why are we torn up in our communities? All our existence has been a living hell. My people are the Israelites. “Because they have no knowledge”: the knowledge is the laws of God. When we don’t have it, we go into captivity and are destroyed. That is the living hell.

We are still slaves today. We have been in slavery and captivity so long that we have normalized it: normalized the abuse, the trauma, broken homes, no daddy at home, our sons going to prison, drugs. We don’t even know what it is to really live. We are dead people.

“And their honourable men are famished”: these are the preachers and pastors you look up to, T.D. Jakes, Rex Humbard, Benny Hinn, Pam, Phillip Anthony Mitchell, especially the black ones. Famished means they themselves are empty of God’s laws. They can’t teach the Bible, so how are they going to teach you? “And their multitude dried up with thirst”: the people listening to the famished leaders are not being fed, because the man who is supposed to feed them has no knowledge to give. They come in sick and go out sicker. No water is being poured on those dry bones. The whole church is dead.

“Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure”. Because we have no knowledge and are not being fed, our condition of hell has gotten worse, and we don’t even know it. We have normalized hell. Many of our people think we will never get out of this, that this is where we belong. Imagine that in five minutes nobody else was ruling and the world was yours: many would be horrified, because we have been so domesticated under tyranny that we say, Daddy feed me, Daddy take care of me. Like the people going crazy over food stamps being cut, then calm the moment they hear it is restored.

“And their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.” Our glory, all we are supposed to be about, is dried up and gone. Everything we have done in this system that was supposed to benefit us, the nations have taken: music, dance, economics, education. We are not going to win this unless we turn back to the Most High, organize the way he told us to under him, and keep his commandments. That is when we will have the hedge of protection in the midst of our enemies.

This is the man made more precious than fine gold, the fame in the land. “Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth”. He will save us that halteth, because we have been held back. The Most High is getting ready to glorify his truth and the brothers and sisters in this gospel.

“And gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.” We have been put to shame. The Most High will beautify the meek with salvation; he is going to clean us up. After two days he will revive us. Great days are coming. We will go through tribulation, and we get these things with persecution, but we know the outcome. This Bible tells you the future, and our enemies don’t want us to know it.

Pam tells the women they can stay in pants, which is an abomination according to the scriptures. On the streets the Israelites pointed to the sisters and read this, and they tried their best not to listen, saying it is in the Old Testament and done away with. Our people hate correction.

Start with the bottom: “neither shall a man put on a woman’s garment”. No men shall be wearing dresses. They are trying to normalize that now, to destroy the whole nation. Nobody questions what that part means, and nobody says it is the Old Testament. They understand it.

Then read the top of the same verse: “The woman shall not wear that which pertaineth unto a man”. Now all of a sudden the Bible doesn’t mean that. That is the selective rebelliousness of our people, and that is why the Lord is going to kill a lot of our sisters and brothers, and these preachers advocating against God’s laws. God will do that, not us. We are only there to warn you; if you won’t hear the warning, now you have to hear the death from the Most High. We have normalized sin and evil, and become so deadened in captivity that we don’t know where we stand with God.

Why do we behave like this, comfortable in hell, so that a letter thanking black people for building this country and serving their oppressor can be read in a church and the people see themselves in every line? It is traumatic bonding with our captor. “Hope deferred maketh the heart sick”: hope deferred makes the mind sick, and we don’t even recognize how sick we are. We have normalized everything; we don’t even want to come out of captivity because we have made captivity normal.

A trauma bond is an unhealthy attachment to the one who abuses you, like a battered wife afraid to leave the man breaking her bones. It was induced in us through trauma: our towns burned, our sons lynched, our women raped, our men castrated, and the whippings meant for everyone to see. So we bonded to white supremacy. Master’s house on fire, my house on fire. If master is upset, I’m upset. When we bring out that Christ is a black man, as the Bible records, the black Christians fight us because it upsets their masters. The black man in him is dead down in the toe of his shoe; all you hear is what white people want him to say.

The abuser cuts you off, then shows a little benevolence, we’ll pay you next week, and you fall back in love all over again. That is why hope deferred makes you crazy: you have no hope you will actually get out.
